title_as_printed: The plasma derived exosomal miRNA-483-5p/502-5p serve as potential MCI biomarkers in aging

blind_codes.Sample_N: 275 surveyed (99 MCI + 176 controls); miRNA cohort 72 (24 MCI + 24 HC>65 + 24 HC<65); ROC on 48

registry_codes.Sample_N_Approx: 275 community elderly screened; miRNA/ROC cohort 72 (24 MCI, 24 age-matched HC, 24 younger HC)

Task_Type.reason: ROC analysis of exosomal miRNA levels for discriminating MCI from age-matched controls, reporting AUC, sensitivity and specificity (miR-483-5p AUC 0.901).
Task_Type.quote: The ROC analysis was performed to assess the diagnostic utility of selected miRNAs in discriminating between MCI.

Category.reason: The registry's C3 captures the primary domain (plasma exosomal miRNA). The paper also reports a community cognitive survey: MoCA and a questionnaire on demographics, lifestyle and chronic disease in 275 elderly, with MCI prevalence and chi-square risk-factor associations in the abstract and Table 2. That is a secondary C5 domain, and the code omits it. Readings: C3 alone, or C3;C5.
Category.quote: A total of 275 participants were enrolled, including 118 females (42.9 %) and 157 males (57.1 %), respectively. 99 participants were found to have MCI based on the criteria of the European Alzheimer's Disease Consortium in 2006.

Validation_Type.reason: The ROC curves are computed on the same 48 participants (24 MCI vs 24 age-matched HC), with no cross-validation, held-out set or external cohort. Under the convention that absence of reporting is V2, V2 applies.

Sample_N_Approx.reason: Both figures are in the paper and the registry says which is which: 275 surveyed (176 controls + 99 MCI) and a 72-person miRNA cohort (24 + 24 + 24). The ROC used 48.
Sample_N_Approx.quote: The miRNA-study cohort included 24 MCI patients, 24 age-matched control and 24 supplemented control group below 65 years.

Publication_Year.reason: Experimental Gerontology 186 (2024); available online 10 January 2024. The DOI stem reads exger.2023, but both the online and issue dates are 2024.

ADNI_Dependent.reason: Community sample from Tianshui, Gansu, China; ADNI is not used.

notes: The 24 younger (<65) controls were recruited in addition to the 275 surveyed participants, who were all over 65, so the study has 299 distinct participants, a total the paper never states. A census that uses 275 therefore omits those 24. The discussion gives prevalence as 35.9% (99/276), against 36.0% of 275 in the results: a minor internal inconsistency in the paper.
